name: Grave Drain
Rules:
Blight (If this kills a hero, it loses its soul.)
Deal 3 damage to target enemy. Heal this hero for the damage dealt.

name: Into the Gloamreach
Rules:
This spell costs 2 less Aura for each empty enemy hero slot. (A slot whose Hero is dead.)
Blight (If this kills a hero, it loses its soul.)
Target hero dies.

name: Curse of Nothingness
Rules: Enchant target hero. Enchanted hero has no soul. (When it dies, it can't be revived or surrendered.)

name: Blood Rune
Rules: Evoke: The attacking hero has lifelink until end of turn. (Damage it deals heals it.) (A Runic weapon evokes Runes when its hero attacks. The Rune stays in your inventory.)

name: Protect Rune
Rules: Evoke: Status counters can't be put on the attacking hero until end of turn. (A Runic weapon evokes Runes when its hero attacks. The Rune stays in your inventory.)

name: Sky Rune
Rules: Evoke: Draw a card. (A Runic weapon evokes Runes when its hero attacks. The Rune stays in your inventory.)
